name: Nahum
lede: The thirty-fourth book of the Bible, in full: the burden of Nineveh, the book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite — Jehovah hath his way in the whirlwind and in the storm; behold, upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings; the chariots rage in the streets, the gates of the rivers are opened; woe to the bloody city — every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: The Burden of Nineveh
books.blurb: Jehovah is a jealous God and avengeth; he hath his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet; Jehovah is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; behold, upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings; he that dasheth in pieces is come up — the chariots rage in the streets, the gates of the rivers are opened, and the palace is dissolved; where is the den of the lions?; woe to the bloody city; art thou better than No-amon?; thy shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria.
